title: Contractor Equipment Arrangements (Informal Guidance)
content: This is an informal note from the IT team regarding contractor equipment. Contractors are generally expected to bring their own devices. The company may provide a temporary loaner laptop in exceptional circumstances, but this is at IT's discretion and subject to availability. There is no formal entitlement for contractors to receive equipment from Acme Corp beyond what is specified in their individual contract. Contractors requiring VPN access must request it through IT helpdesk. This note does not constitute official policy and may not reflect the current IT Director's position on equipment provision for contractors.
